recommendations.title: Refresh: Add step-by-step local checklist for Stockholm homeowners
recommendations.details: Create a short, actionable checklist on the Stockholm guide page that tells homeowners how to check whether their property needs building permission: 1) lookup address in Stockholms stads detaljplan/karta (link), 2) check Stadsmuseets klassificeringskarta for kulturvärden (link), 3) search for riksintressen (e.g. Håtuna radar) and how proximity is assessed, 4) what information to have ready when contacting stadsbyggnadskontoret (fastighetsbeteckning, bilder, planlösning, planerad kW/antal paneler). Include estimated timelines and expected fee info. Keep it concise and beginner-friendly.
